definition.name: lookup_verdicts
definition.description: Decide every comment of a keyed scan that trusted and blocked authors, blocked terms and remembered verdicts can decide, and group the rest so each distinct comment in its context is asked about once, shown with what its media shows.

implementations.source:
"""Decide every comment Elder Sign can decide without a model, and group the rest.

The input is a scan `normalize_comments` keyed. Each comment goes through
these layers in order, and the first that knows decides it:

1. `trusted_author`: the author is trusted, so the comment is friendly;
2. `blocked_author`: the author is blocked, so the comment is hostile;
3. `nothing_to_judge`: the comment has neither words nor media it can be
   recognized by, so there is nothing to hold against it;
4. `blocked_term`: its normalized text contains a blocked term;
5. `media`: one of its GIFs or images was judged hostile on its own;
6. `content`: its content was judged, in a way that holds in any thread;
7. `context`: its content was judged in reply to this same parent content.

What no layer decides needs a model. Those comments are grouped by their
context, or by their content when their parent is unknown, so that a swarm's
hundred copies of one comment under one parent are asked about once. Each
group carries one comment and its parent, as a model is shown them.

A model is shown a comment's words and, for each GIF or image, its
description from when `judge-media` looked at it, never the media itself. It
is shown what the post says, its `caption`, and which comments the person
wrote herself, marked `by_her`, so her answers to trolls read as hers. A
group whose comment or parent has media no model has described yet names it
in `undescribed_media`, with the URL to fetch it from, so the scan can have
it judged before the words beside it are.

This tool only reads the state file: `record_verdicts` keeps what a model
decides.
"""


# --- elder_sign.shared.protocol ---

import json
import sys
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

JsonObject = dict[str, Any]
"""A JSON object, as a tool receives its inputs and returns its outputs."""


def main(
    run: Callable[[JsonObject], JsonObject],
) -> None:
    """Read the tool's inputs from standard input, run it, and write its outputs."""

    inputs = json.load(sys.stdin)

    if not isinstance(inputs, dict):
        raise SystemExit("An Elder Sign tool takes one JSON object as its inputs.")

    json.dump(run(inputs), sys.stdout, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)


# --- elder_sign.shared.keys ---

import hashlib
import re
import unicodedata
from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping, Sequence
from typing import Any, Final
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

ZERO_WIDTH: Final = frozenset("​‌‍‎‏⁠⁡⁢⁣⁤﻿")
"""Characters that render as nothing, used to break up a word a filter would catch."""

HOMOGLYPHS: Final[Mapping[str, str]] = {
    # Cyrillic
    "а": "a",
    "в": "b",
    "е": "e",
    "ё": "e",
    "к": "k",
    "м": "m",
    "н": "h",
    "о": "o",
    "р": "p",
    "с": "c",
    "т": "t",
    "у": "y",
    "х": "x",
    "і": "i",
    "ї": "i",
    "ј": "j",
    "ѕ": "s",
    "ԁ": "d",
    "ԛ": "q",
    "ԝ": "w",
    "ɡ": "g",
    # Greek
    "α": "a",
    "β": "b",
    "ε": "e",
    "η": "n",
    "ι": "i",
    "κ": "k",
    "ν": "v",
    "ο": "o",
    "ρ": "p",
    "τ": "t",
    "υ": "u",
    "χ": "x",
    "ω": "w",
    # Latin look-alikes
    "ı": "i",
    "ł": "l",
    "ø": "o",
    "đ": "d",
    "ß": "ss",
}
"""Letters from other scripts that look like Latin letters, as the Latin letter they imitate."""

LEET: Final[Mapping[str, str]] = {
    "0": "o",
    "1": "i",
    "3": "e",
    "4": "a",
    "5": "s",
    "7": "t",
    "8": "b",
    "9": "g",
    "@": "a",
    "$": "s",
    "!": "i",
    "|": "l",
    "+": "t",
}
"""Digits and symbols written for letters, folded only inside a word that has a letter."""

REPEATS: Final = re.compile(r"(.)\1{2,}")
"""Three or more of one character, squeezed to one: `yyyy` and `!!!` but not `oo`."""

PHRASE_BREAK: Final = re.compile(r"\s{2,}|\n")
"""A wider gap, or a new line, ends a word spelled out letter by letter: `y o u  w i l l`."""

DIGEST_LENGTH: Final = 32
"""How many hex digits of a SHA-256 digest a key keeps: 128 bits."""

GIPHY_MEDIA: Final = re.compile(r"/media/(?:v1\.[^/]+/)?([A-Za-z0-9]+)/")
"""A Giphy media URL: `media.giphy.com/media/<id>/giphy.gif`."""

GIPHY_PAGE: Final = re.compile(r"/gifs/(?:[^/]*-)?([A-Za-z0-9]+)/?$")
"""A Giphy page URL: `giphy.com/gifs/<words>-<id>`."""

TENOR_MEDIA: Final = re.compile(r"^/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+?)(?:AAAA[A-Za-z])?/")
"""A Tenor media URL: `media.tenor.com/<id><rendition>/<name>.gif`, every rendition one GIF."""


def _digest(
    *parts: str,
) -> str:
    """Return the shortened SHA-256 digest of some parts, kept apart from each other."""

    return hashlib.sha256("\x1f".join(parts).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:DIGEST_LENGTH]


def _is_dropped(
    character: str,
) -> bool:
    """Return whether a character is punctuation or a non-emoji symbol, which keys ignore."""

    category = unicodedata.category(character)

    return category.startswith("P") or category in ("Sm", "Sc", "Sk")


LEADING_LEET: Final = frozenset("@$")
"""Symbols that stand for a letter even at the start of a word: `@ss`, `$hit`."""


def _fold_token(
    token: str,
) -> str:
    """Fold one whitespace-separated token: look-alikes, then leetspeak, then punctuation.

    Punctuation at the end of a word is emphasis, not a letter, so `tranny!!!`
    is `tranny`, not `trannyi`; at the start, only `@` and `$` are letters.
    """

    folded = "".join(HOMOGLYPHS.get(character, character) for character in token)
    end = len(folded)

    while end > 0 and _is_dropped(folded[end - 1]):
        end -= 1

    start = 0

    while start < end and _is_dropped(folded[start]) and folded[start] not in LEADING_LEET:
        start += 1

    folded = folded[start:end]

    if any(character.isalpha() for character in folded):
        folded = "".join(LEET.get(character, character) for character in folded)

    return "".join(character for character in folded if not _is_dropped(character))


def _join_spelled_out(
    tokens: Sequence[str],
) -> list[str]:
    """Join runs of three or more single letters, so `t r a n n y` is one word.

    A run is joined within one phrase: a wider gap ends it, so `y o u  w i l l`
    is two words. Letters spelled out with single spaces throughout cannot be
    told apart into words, and are joined into one.
    """

    joined: list[str] = []
    run: list[str] = []

    for token in (*tokens, ""):
        if len(token) == 1 and token.isalpha():
            run.append(token)
            continue

        if len(run) >= 3:
            joined.append("".join(run))
        else:
            joined.extend(run)

        run = []

        if token:
            joined.append(token)

    return joined


def normalize_text(
    text: str,
    mentions: Iterable[str] = (),
) -> str:
    """Fold a comment's text into the one spelling every disguise of it shares.

    The names it mentions are removed first, so the same reply to two people
    is one comment.
    """

    for mention in sorted(set(mentions), key=len, reverse=True):
        if mention.strip():
            text = text.replace(mention, " ")

    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", text)
    text = "".join(character for character in text if character not in ZERO_WIDTH)
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text.casefold())
    text = "".join(character for character in text if unicodedata.category(character) != "Mn")

    words: list[str] = []

    for phrase in PHRASE_BREAK.split(text.strip()):
        tokens = [_fold_token(token) for token in phrase.split()]
        words.extend(_join_spelled_out([REPEATS.sub(r"\1", token) for token in tokens if token]))

    return " ".join(words)


def text_key(
    normalized: str,
) -> str | None:
    """Return the key of normalized text, or none when it has no words."""

    return f"t:{_digest(normalized)}" if normalized else None


def media_key(
    media: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> str | None:
    """Return the key of one GIF, sticker or image, or none when nothing identifies it.

    The provider's own ID is used when the platform gives one; otherwise it is
    read from a Giphy or Tenor URL; otherwise the URL's path, without its host
    or query, which on a CDN vary for the same file.
    """

    provider = str(media.get("provider") or "").strip().lower()
    provider_id = str(media.get("provider_id") or "").strip()

    if provider and provider_id:
        return f"m:{provider}:{provider_id}"

    url = str(media.get("url") or "").strip()

    if not url:
        return None

    parts = urlsplit(url)
    host = parts.netloc.lower()

    if host == "giphy.com" or host.endswith(".giphy.com"):
        found = GIPHY_MEDIA.search(parts.path) or GIPHY_PAGE.search(parts.path)

        if found:
            return f"m:giphy:{found.group(1)}"

    if host == "media.tenor.com" or host.endswith(".tenor.com"):
        found = TENOR_MEDIA.search(parts.path)

        if found:
            return f"m:tenor:{found.group(1)}"

    return f"m:url:{_digest(parts.path)}" if parts.path.strip("/") else None


def content_key(
    text: str | None,
    media: Sequence[str],
) -> str | None:
    """Return the key of a comment's text and media together, or none when it has neither."""

    if text is None and not media:
        return None

    return f"c:{_digest(text or '', *sorted(media))}"


def context_key(
    content: str | None,
    parent_content: str | None,
    *,
    top_level: bool,
    post: str | None = None,
) -> str | None:
    """Return the key of a comment's content in reply to its parent's.

    A top-level comment replies to the post, so its context is that post,
    named by `post`: "oh dear" under a date means something else under a
    loss. A reply whose parent's content is unknown has no context key: two
    such replies may answer different things.
    """

    if content is None:
        return None

    if top_level:
        return f"x:{_digest(content, f'post:{post}' if post else 'post')}"

    if parent_content is None:
        return None

    return f"x:{_digest(content, parent_content)}"


PREFIX_WILDCARD: Final = "*"
"""A blocked term ending in `*` matches any word its last word begins: `trann*`."""


def term_matches(
    normalized: str,
    term: str,
) -> bool:
    """Return whether a blocked term appears in normalized text, as whole words.

    The term is normalized as the text was, so a term written `Tr4nny` blocks
    every disguise of it. A term matches only whole words, so blocking one
    word never blocks a longer word that happens to contain it, unless the
    term ends in `*`.
    """

    prefix = term.rstrip().endswith(PREFIX_WILDCARD)
    wanted = normalize_text(term.rstrip().rstrip(PREFIX_WILDCARD)).split()
    words = normalized.split()

    if not wanted:
        return False

    for start in range(len(words) - len(wanted) + 1):
        window = words[start : start + len(wanted)]

        if window[:-1] != wanted[:-1]:
            continue

        last, expected = window[-1], wanted[-1]

        if last == expected or (prefix and last.startswith(expected)):
            return True

    return False


# --- elder_sign.shared.store ---

import os
import sqlite3
from collections.abc import Iterator, Mapping
from contextlib import contextmanager
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Final

DATABASE_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE: Final = "ELDER_SIGN_DB"
"""The variable naming the state file, granted to every tool that opens it."""

SCHEMA_VERSION: Final = 3
"""The schema version this Elder Sign writes, kept in SQLite's `user_version`."""

BUSY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: Final = 30.0
"""How long a writer waits for another to finish before it fails."""

VERDICTS: Final = ("friendly", "hostile", "uncertain")
"""What can be decided about a comment."""

KEY_KINDS: Final = ("content", "context")
"""A verdict about a comment's content wherever it appears, or about it in reply to its parent."""

VERDICT_SOURCES: Final = ("model", "human")
"""Who decided: a human's verdict is never replaced by a model's."""

STANDINGS: Final = ("trusted", "blocked")
"""An author's standing."""

ACTIONS: Final = ("hide", "unhide", "delete", "restrict")
"""What Elder Sign can do to a comment or its author."""

ACTION_STATUSES: Final = ("planned", "done", "failed")
"""Where an action stands."""

MIGRATIONS: Final = (
    """
    CREATE TABLE posts (
        platform TEXT NOT NULL,
        post_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        comment_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (comment_count >= 0),
        newest_comment_id TEXT,
        recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (platform, post_id)
    );

    CREATE TABLE verdicts (
        policy TEXT NOT NULL,
        key_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (key_kind IN ('content', 'context')),
        key TEXT NOT NULL,
        verdict TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (verdict IN ('friendly', 'hostile', 'uncertain')),
        source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('model', 'human')),
        model TEXT,
        reason TEXT,
        recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (policy, key_kind, key)
    );

    CREATE TABLE authors (
        platform TEXT NOT NULL,
        author_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        standing TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (standing IN ('trusted', 'blocked')),
        note TEXT,
        recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (platform, author_id)
    );

    CREATE TABLE terms (
        policy TEXT NOT NULL,
        term TEXT NOT NULL,
        recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (policy, term)
    );

    CREATE TABLE actions (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        platform TEXT NOT NULL,
        post_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        comment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('hide', 'unhide', 'delete', 'restrict')),
        verdict TEXT,
        layer TEXT,
        dry_run INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (dry_run IN (0, 1)),
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('planned', 'done', 'failed')),
        detail TEXT,
        recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL
    );

    CREATE INDEX actions_by_comment ON actions (platform, comment_id);
    """,
    """
    CREATE TABLE media (
        media_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        description TEXT NOT NULL,
        model TEXT,
        recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    """,
    """
    CREATE TABLE flags (
        name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        value TEXT NOT NULL,
        reason TEXT,
        recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL
    );
    """,
)
"""The script that brings the schema from each version to the next; version N runs script N - 1."""


class StoreError(RuntimeError):
    """Raised when the state file cannot be used, or is asked to keep something invalid."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Fingerprint:
    """What a post's comments looked like when it was last cleaned."""

    comment_count: int
    newest_comment_id: str | None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Flag:
    """Something Elder Sign keeps of itself, by name, and why."""

    value: str
    reason: str | None
    recorded_at: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Verdict:
    """What was decided about one key under one policy, and by whom."""

    verdict: str
    source: str
    model: str | None
    reason: str | None


def database_path(
    environment: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
) -> Path:
    """Return the state file: `ELDER_SIGN_DB`, or `~/.elder-sign/state.db`."""

    environment = os.environ if environment is None else environment
    configured = environment.get(DATABASE_ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLE, "").strip()

    if configured:
        return Path(configured).expanduser()

    return Path.home() / ".elder-sign" / "state.db"


def recorded_now() -> str:
    """Return the current time as it is recorded: UTC, ISO 8601, to the second."""

    return datetime.now(UTC).replace(microsecond=0).isoformat()


def _require(
    value: str,
    allowed: tuple[str, ...],
    what: str,
) -> None:
    """Refuse a value outside one of the schema's vocabularies."""

    if value not in allowed:
        raise StoreError(f"{what} {value!r} is not one of {', '.join(allowed)}.")


def migrate(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
) -> None:
    """Bring the state file to the current schema, one version at a time.

    Raises:
        StoreError: The file was written by a newer Elder Sign.
    """

    (version,) = connection.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()

    if version > SCHEMA_VERSION:
        raise StoreError(
            f"The state file has schema version {version}, newer than this Elder Sign's "
            f"{SCHEMA_VERSION}; upgrade Elder Sign to use it."
        )

    while version < SCHEMA_VERSION:
        connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

        try:
            (current,) = connection.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()

            if current == version:
                for statement in MIGRATIONS[version].split(";"):
                    if statement.strip():
                        connection.execute(statement)

                connection.execute(f"PRAGMA user_version = {version + 1}")

            connection.execute("COMMIT")
        except BaseException:
            connection.execute("ROLLBACK")
            raise

        (version,) = connection.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()


def connect(
    path: Path | None = None,
) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Open the state file, creating and migrating it as needed.

    The connection is in autocommit mode: each write stands on its own, and a
    group of writes that must stand together is wrapped in `transaction`.
    """

    path = database_path() if path is None else path
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    connection = sqlite3.connect(path, timeout=BUSY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, isolation_level=None)

    try:
        connection.execute(f"PRAGMA busy_timeout = {int(BUSY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS * 1000)}")
        connection.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL")
        connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
        migrate(connection)
    except BaseException:
        connection.close()
        raise

    return connection


@contextmanager
def transaction(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
) -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:
    """Run a group of writes as one: all of them stand, or none do."""

    connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

    try:
        yield connection
    except BaseException:
        connection.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise

    connection.execute("COMMIT")


def read_fingerprint(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    platform: str,
    post_id: str,
) -> Fingerprint | None:
    """Return a post's fingerprint from when it was last cleaned, if it ever was."""

    row = connection.execute(
        "SELECT comment_count, newest_comment_id FROM posts WHERE platform = ? AND post_id = ?",
        (platform, post_id),
    ).fetchone()

    return None if row is None else Fingerprint(comment_count=row[0], newest_comment_id=row[1])


def write_fingerprint(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    platform: str,
    post_id: str,
    fingerprint: Fingerprint,
) -> None:
    """Keep a post's fingerprint, replacing the one before."""

    if fingerprint.comment_count < 0:
        raise StoreError(f"A post cannot have {fingerprint.comment_count} comments.")

    connection.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO posts (platform, post_id, comment_count, newest_comment_id, recorded_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT (platform, post_id) DO UPDATE SET
            comment_count = excluded.comment_count,
            newest_comment_id = excluded.newest_comment_id,
            recorded_at = excluded.recorded_at
        """,
        (
            platform,
            post_id,
            fingerprint.comment_count,
            fingerprint.newest_comment_id,
            recorded_now(),
        ),
    )


def read_verdict(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    policy: str,
    key_kind: str,
    key: str,
) -> Verdict | None:
    """Return what was decided about one key under one policy, if anything was."""

    _require(key_kind, KEY_KINDS, "Key kind")

    row = connection.execute(
        """
        SELECT verdict, source, model, reason FROM verdicts
        WHERE policy = ? AND key_kind = ? AND key = ?
        """,
        (policy, key_kind, key),
    ).fetchone()

    return (
        None if row is None else Verdict(verdict=row[0], source=row[1], model=row[2], reason=row[3])
    )


def write_verdict(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    policy: str,
    key_kind: str,
    key: str,
    verdict: Verdict,
) -> bool:
    """Keep what was decided about one key, unless a human decided it and this is a model.

    Writing the same verdict again changes nothing, so a resumed run may
    repeat its writes. Returns whether the verdict was kept.
    """

    _require(key_kind, KEY_KINDS, "Key kind")
    _require(verdict.verdict, VERDICTS, "Verdict")
    _require(verdict.source, VERDICT_SOURCES, "Verdict source")

    cursor = connection.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO verdicts (policy, key_kind, key, verdict, source, model, reason, recorded_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT (policy, key_kind, key) DO UPDATE SET
            verdict = excluded.verdict,
            source = excluded.source,
            model = excluded.model,
            reason = excluded.reason,
            recorded_at = excluded.recorded_at
        WHERE verdicts.source = 'model' OR excluded.source = 'human'
        """,
        (
            policy,
            key_kind,
            key,
            verdict.verdict,
            verdict.source,
            verdict.model,
            verdict.reason,
            recorded_now(),
        ),
    )

    return cursor.rowcount == 1


def read_standing(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    platform: str,
    author_id: str,
) -> str | None:
    """Return whether an author is trusted or blocked, if either."""

    row = connection.execute(
        "SELECT standing FROM authors WHERE platform = ? AND author_id = ?",
        (platform, author_id),
    ).fetchone()

    return None if row is None else str(row[0])


def write_standing(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    platform: str,
    author_id: str,
    standing: str,
    note: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Trust or block an author, replacing their standing before."""

    _require(standing, STANDINGS, "Standing")

    connection.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO authors (platform, author_id, standing, note, recorded_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT (platform, author_id) DO UPDATE SET
            standing = excluded.standing,
            note = excluded.note,
            recorded_at = excluded.recorded_at
        """,
        (platform, author_id, standing, note, recorded_now()),
    )


def forget_standing(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    platform: str,
    author_id: str,
) -> None:
    """Make an author neither trusted nor blocked."""

    connection.execute(
        "DELETE FROM authors WHERE platform = ? AND author_id = ?",
        (platform, author_id),
    )


def read_terms(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    policy: str,
) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Return the terms that make a comment hostile under one policy, in order."""

    return tuple(
        str(row[0])
        for row in connection.execute(
            "SELECT term FROM terms WHERE policy = ? ORDER BY term",
            (policy,),
        )
    )


def write_term(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    policy: str,
    term: str,
) -> None:
    """Add a term that makes a comment hostile under one policy, as it was written."""

    if not term.strip():
        raise StoreError("A blocked term cannot be blank.")

    connection.execute(
        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO terms (policy, term, recorded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (policy, term.strip(), recorded_now()),
    )


def forget_term(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    policy: str,
    term: str,
) -> None:
    """Remove a term from a policy."""

    connection.execute(
        "DELETE FROM terms WHERE policy = ? AND term = ?",
        (policy, term.strip()),
    )


def read_description(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    media_key: str,
) -> str | None:
    """Return what one GIF or image shows, if it was ever described."""

    row = connection.execute(
        "SELECT description FROM media WHERE media_key = ?",
        (media_key,),
    ).fetchone()

    return None if row is None else str(row[0])


def write_description(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    media_key: str,
    description: str,
    model: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Keep what one GIF or image shows, replacing what was kept before."""

    if not description.strip():
        raise StoreError("A media description cannot be blank.")

    connection.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO media (media_key, description, model, recorded_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT (media_key) DO UPDATE SET
            description = excluded.description,
            model = excluded.model,
            recorded_at = excluded.recorded_at
        """,
        (media_key, description.strip(), model, recorded_now()),
    )


def read_flag(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    name: str,
) -> Flag | None:
    """Return a flag, if it is set."""

    row = connection.execute(
        "SELECT value, reason, recorded_at FROM flags WHERE name = ?",
        (name,),
    ).fetchone()

    return None if row is None else Flag(value=row[0], reason=row[1], recorded_at=row[2])


def write_flag(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    name: str,
    value: str,
    reason: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Set a flag, replacing it if it was set."""

    if not name.strip() or not value:
        raise StoreError("A flag needs a name and a value.")

    connection.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO flags (name, value, reason, recorded_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET
            value = excluded.value,
            reason = excluded.reason,
            recorded_at = excluded.recorded_at
        """,
        (name.strip(), value, reason, recorded_now()),
    )


def forget_flag(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    name: str,
) -> None:
    """Clear a flag; clearing one never set changes nothing."""

    connection.execute("DELETE FROM flags WHERE name = ?", (name,))


def forget_model_verdicts(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    policy: str | None = None,
) -> int:
    """Forget every verdict a model gave on comments, under one policy or all; return how many.

    A human's verdicts are kept, and so are a model's verdicts on GIFs and
    images on their own, which were judged by looking at them, not by the
    words a prompt shows.
    """

    cursor = connection.execute(
        """
        DELETE FROM verdicts
        WHERE source = 'model' AND key NOT LIKE 'm:%' AND (? IS NULL OR policy = ?)
        """,
        (policy, policy),
    )

    return int(cursor.rowcount)

def _shown(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    comment: JsonObject,
    undescribed: dict[str, JsonObject],
    owner_id: str | None,
) -> JsonObject:
    """Return the part of a comment a model is shown, noting media not yet described.

    Each GIF or image is shown as its kind and description; media no model
    has described is shown with no description, and noted in `undescribed`.
    A comment the person wrote herself is marked `by_her`.
    """

    shown: JsonObject = {field: comment[field] for field in SHOWN_FIELDS if field in comment}

    if owner_id is not None and str(comment.get("author_id")) == owner_id:
        shown["by_her"] = True
    media: list[JsonObject] = []

    for item in comment.get("media") or ():
        key = media_key(item)
        description = None if key is None else read_description(connection, key)
        kind = item.get("kind")
        media.append({"kind": kind, "description": description})

        if key is not None and description is None and key not in undescribed:
            undescribed[key] = {"media_key": key, "kind": kind, "url": item.get("url")}

    if media:
        shown["media"] = media

    return shown


def _decide(
    connection: sqlite3.Connection,
    platform: str,
    policy: str,
    terms: tuple[str, ...],
    comment: JsonObject,
) -> tuple[str, str, str | None] | None:
    """Return the verdict, layer and source that decide a comment, or none when a model must."""

    standing = read_standing(connection, platform, str(comment["author_id"]))

    if standing == "trusted":
        return "friendly", "trusted_author", None

    if standing == "blocked":
        return "hostile", "blocked_author", None

    keys: JsonObject = comment["keys"]

    if keys["content"] is None:
        return "friendly", "nothing_to_judge", None

    normalized = str(comment.get("normalized") or "")

    if any(term_matches(normalized, term) for term in terms):
        return "hostile", "blocked_term", None

    for media in keys["media"]:
        found = read_verdict(connection, policy, "content", media)

        if found is not None and found.verdict == "hostile":
            return "hostile", "media", found.source

    found = read_verdict(connection, policy, "content", keys["content"])

    if found is not None:
        return found.verdict, "content", found.source

    if keys["context"] is not None:
        found = read_verdict(connection, policy, "context", keys["context"])

        if found is not None:
            return found.verdict, "context", found.source

    return None


def run(
    inputs: JsonObject,
) -> JsonObject:
    """Return what every layer decided, and the groups only a model can decide."""

    scan: JsonObject = inputs["scan"]
    policy = str(inputs["settings"]["policy"])
    platform = str(scan["platform"])
    caption = scan.get("caption")
    owner = scan.get("owner_id")
    owner_id = str(owner) if owner else None
    comments: list[JsonObject] = list(scan["comments"])
    by_id = {str(comment["id"]): comment for comment in comments}

    resolved: list[JsonObject] = []
    groups: dict[tuple[str, str], JsonObject] = {}
    undescribed: dict[str, JsonObject] = {}
    layers: dict[str, int] = {}

    connection = connect()

    try:
        terms = read_terms(connection, policy)

        for comment in comments:
            decided = _decide(connection, platform, policy, terms, comment)

            if decided is not None:
                verdict, layer, source = decided
                layers[layer] = layers.get(layer, 0) + 1
                resolved.append(
                    {
                        "comment_id": str(comment["id"]),
                        "verdict": verdict,
                        "layer": layer,
                        "source": source,
                    }
                )
                continue

            keys: JsonObject = comment["keys"]
            grouping = (
                ("context", str(keys["context"]))
                if keys["context"] is not None
                else ("content", str(keys["content"]))
            )

            if grouping in groups:
                groups[grouping]["comment_ids"].append(str(comment["id"]))
                continue

            parent_id = comment.get("parent_id")
            parent: Any = by_id.get(str(parent_id)) if parent_id is not None else None

            groups[grouping] = {
                "content_key": keys["content"],
                "context_key": keys["context"],
                "media_keys": list(keys["media"]),
                "comment_ids": [str(comment["id"])],
                "comment": _shown(connection, comment, undescribed, owner_id),
                "parent": None
                if parent is None or parent is comment
                else _shown(connection, parent, undescribed, owner_id),
                "caption": str(caption) if caption else None,
            }
    finally:
        connection.close()

    return {
        "resolution": {
            "platform": platform,
            "post_id": str(scan["post_id"]),
            "policy": policy,
            "resolved": resolved,
            "needs_inference": list(groups.values()),
            "undescribed_media": list(undescribed.values()),
            "layers": layers,
        }
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(run)
